question.text: If the normals at two points <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> of the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></math> meets again on the parabola, where <math><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>-</mo><msub><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Let, x1,y1≡t12,2t1 & x2,y2≡t22,2t2

Now, x1+x2=8 and both the normals again meets on the parabola, 

∴ t12+t22=8 & t1t2=2

On solving, we get,
t1-t22=4⇒t1-t2=2⇒y1-y2=4
